# Copilot Instructions

Read and follow the repository-wide guidance in `AGENTS.md` before making changes.

Use `.ai/llms.txt` to locate official Bun, Elysia, Prisma, Zod, and Scalar documentation before using framework APIs.

Documentation is organized by audience:

- `docs/dev`: development, tooling, architecture, and scaffolding.
- `docs/user`: API consumers, deployment users, and product usage.

When changing code, keep the relevant documentation current and run `bun run quality`.
